sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products LIMIT 101
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories LIMIT 101

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 101

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.title, ph.price, ph.scraped_at
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.title = 'The Hidden Harbour'
ORDER BY ph.scraped_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(ph.price)
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id
WHERE p.title = 'The Crimson Mirror' LIMIT 101

SELECT p.title, ph.price
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
WHERE ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id)
ORDER BY ph.price DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
WHERE ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id) AND ph.in_stock = 0 LIMIT 101

SELECT p.title
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
WHERE ph.price < 10 LIMIT 101

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM price_history
WHERE scraped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND scraped_at < '2026-10-01' LIMIT 101

SELECT AVG(ph.price) AS avg_price
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE c.name = 'Travel' AND ph.scraped_at >= '2026-08-01' AND ph.scraped_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 101

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM price_alerts
WHERE triggered_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 101

SELECT p.title
FROM products p JOIN price_alerts pa ON pa.product_id = p.id
WHERE pa.triggered_at IS NULL LIMIT 101

SELECT p.title, ph.price
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE c.name = 'Poetry'
ORDER BY ph.price ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE c.name = 'Fiction' AND ph.price > 30 AND ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = ph.product_id) LIMIT 101

SELECT MAX(ph.price) AS max_price
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE c.name = 'Science' LIMIT 101

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id AND ph.in_stock = 0
WHERE ph.product_id IS NULL LIMIT 101

SELECT c.name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id
WHERE ph.price > 30
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(ph.price) > 30 LIMIT 101

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ph.price)
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id
WHERE p.title = 'The Forgotten Mirror' LIMIT 101
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_history LIMIT 101

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM price_history
WHERE scraped_at = '2026-09-30' LIMIT 101
